title: Chambers Litigation Support 2025 Guide recognizes Burford and its global team
summary: Chambers 2025 Litigation Support rankings are now available. We are pleased to share that Burford ranked Band 1 for US litigation funding, US intellectual property, Middle East litigation funding and international arbitration.
body_markdown:
Chambers 2025 Litigation Support rankings are now available. We are pleased to share that Burford ranked Band 1 for US litigation funding, US intellectual property, Middle East litigation funding and international arbitration. Congratulations to[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) ,[Aviva Will](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/aviva-will/) ,Michael Redman ,[Katharine Wolanyk](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/) ,[Quentin Pak](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/quentin-pak/) ,[Eric Carlson](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/eric-carlson/) ,[Jörn Eschment](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/joern-eschment/) ,Emily Tillett and[Chris Freeman](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-freeman/) for being recognized.


[See here for the complete rankings and individual rankings.](https://chambers.com/law-firm/burford-capital-llc-litigation-support-58:23028689)
